_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "mfa_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mfa_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "dark_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dark_mode" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_roles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "role_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roles (id), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("user_id", "role_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "modules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "module_permissions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "module_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES modules (id), "can_create" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("can_create" IN (0, 1)), "can_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("can_read" IN (0, 1)), "can_update" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("can_update" IN (0, 1)), "can_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("can_delete" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("user_id", "module_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "price_a" REAL NOT NULL, "price_b" REAL NOT NULL, "production_cost" REAL NULL, "stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "materials" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unidad', "stock" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "price_per_unit" REAL NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_materials" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "material_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES materials (id), "quantity_used" REAL NOT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("product_id", "material_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "city" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_info" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_info" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "location_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "event_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES events (id), "total_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "discount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "final_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sale_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" REAL NOT NULL, "price_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', "subtotal" REAL NOT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "supplier_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "location_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "event_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES events (id), "is_material" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_material" IN (0, 1)), "description" TEXT NULL, "total_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "purchase_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "material_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES materials (id), "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_price" REAL NOT NULL, "subtotal" REAL NOT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_reports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "filters" TEXT NOT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "module_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NULL, "record_id" INTEGER NULL, "old_value" TEXT NULL, "new_value" TEXT NULL, "sincronizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sincronizado" IN (0, 1)), "supabase_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sesion_local" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "activa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activa" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
